1.title: We Beat HackerOne Using China’s Open-Weight GLM | Pavel Gurvich
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Cybersecurity CEO discusses using open-weight Chinese LLM models to win HackerOne competition, shift from vulnerability discovery to mass-scale breach capability, and why legacy security vendors fail against AI-driven attacks.

1.title: We Built An AI Coworker At YC That You Can Use For Free
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: YC Labs built QM, an open-source multiplayer agent harness. The video walks through what changed in YC's building approach over 6 months, demos the tool, covers token management and task patterns YC teams are actually using it for, and discusses implications for builders.

2.title: Why I Reject Flirty AI Companions | Mina Fahmi
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Mina Fahmi (ex-Meta, Magic Leap neural interfaces) discusses Stream, a whisper-activated AI ring, and why current AI companions create friction and parasocial traps; explores wearable design, sci-fi imagination, and "thought symbiosis" over flirty interfaces.
